#2. Parameterisation of surface losses

##2.1 Intertidal and subtidal zone above 5m
```{r}

getwd()

library(raster)
library(sf)

r <- raster("~Mean_depth.nc",  varname = "elevation",stopIfNotEqualSpaced = FALSE)
plot(r)

aire<- function(pl, seuil){
  vals <- getValues(pl) 
  z<-(subset(vals, vals <= seuil))# seuil = max(se+sp)->threshold
  length(z)*mean(getValues(raster::area(pl)))
}

xy <- data.frame(xyFromCell(r, 1:ncell(r)))
v2 <- (getValues(r))*-1
xy[,"prof"] <- v2
coordinates(xy) <- ~x+y
gridded(xy) <- TRUE
p2020 <- raster(xy)
maps<- plot(p2020)


mask_shp <- st_read("~habitat_loss/mask_5m.shp") %>% 
  st_transform( crs = 4326) 

p2020.m <- crop(p2020, extent(mask_shp))
p2020.m2 <- mask(p2020.m, mask_shp)
plot(p2020.m2)

aire_5m <- (aire(p2020.m2, 5))-(aire(p2020.m2, 0))
aire_5m #2846.376 all -> 2155.958 km^2 for east coast of irish sea

```

##2.2 Surface restoration factor
```{r}

##
aire_5m<- 2155.958
aire_intertidal <- 1183 #aire au dessus du 0 des cartes

aire_total <- aire_5m+aire_intertidal #addition de l'aire au dessus de 5 et 0m car 
Perte_Stamp <- 538
aire_total_historic <- aire_total+Perte_Stamp
Sloss <- ((Perte_Stamp)/aire_total_historic)
Sloss

# Sloss <- ((Perte_Stamp)/(aire_5m+aire_intertidal+Perte_Stamp))

Srestoration <- 1/(1-Sloss)
Srestoration <- round(Srestoration, digits =2)
Srestoration

Prop <- 0.4971

s= 1/(1+((Prop)*Srestoration)-(Prop))
s
#0.9263239

```


#3. Effect of scenarios on h and K

Once habitat change scenarios are set up, a h and a K can be calculated under the effect of these scenarios.

```{r}

source("R/multiplier_function.R")
a <- multiplier_fun(1,s, h, K, 3*log(10), deltaT = deltaT, Wbar)

h <- a$h #not impacte by surface only scenario
K <- a$K
```

Effects of surface restoration on h and K parameters are now incorporated into the modelled population 

#4. Simulation of nursery restoration on population dynamics

New values of h and K are used to simulate the population dynamics 

Caution: for the new dynamics to be compared, you need a reference state = the script you have just done but without the surface restoration. Run the Reference chunks for that (Ks=K and s=1). Then write a "new_ref" file with this reference dynamic.

```{r}
s <- 1
Ks <- K
```

## 4.1 MSY values
```{r}
source("R/mean_nondyn.R")
mean_nondyn()
DYN=F
MSYsearch=TRUE

#set analysis details
studied_outputs='both' #what output do you want to save  "catch" "SSB" or "both"
path_simulation="Simulation/" #where the output will be save
sc_name=paste0(stock,"test_ref") #simulation name
F_combinations =  seq(0,1.5,0.01) #explored range of F

source("R/MSY_wraper.R")

# effacer les .txt ou changer de nom /!\
purrr::map_dbl(F_combinations,MSY_wraper,
               value_of_interest = studied_outputs ,
               n_traj=1,years= years,path_simulation=path_simulation, simulation.name= sc_name) 

MSY <- read.table(paste0("Simulation/MSY_",sc_name,".txt"),header=T)

#get MSY value
MSY %>%
  filter(Zone=="ALL") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Zone,F,sim),names_from=type,values_from=c(mean),values_fn = mean) %>%
  filter(C==max(C)) 
```

## 4.2 New population dynamics analysis 

Comparison of the new population dynamics with the old one (without restoration)

```{r}
# Chargement de la dynamique sans scénarios 
MSY_ref <- read.table(paste0("Simulation/MSY_",stock,"ref2.txt"),header=T) %>% 
  filter(Zone=="ALL") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Zone,F,sim),names_from=type,values_from=c(mean),values_fn = mean) %>%
  filter(C==max(C))

# Chargement de la dynamique avec les scénarios a analyser
MSY <- read.table(paste0("Simulation/MSY_",stock,"surf2.txt"),header=T) %>% 
  filter(Zone=="ALL") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Zone,F,sim),names_from=type,values_from=c(mean),values_fn = mean) %>%
  filter(C==max(C)) 

### Changement par rapport au scénario de référence 
# F
MSY$F-MSY_ref$F

# SSBmsy
(MSY$SSB/MSY_ref$SSB)

# Captures
(MSY$C/MSY_ref$C)
```


## 4.3  Graphic layout

### 4.3.a Model/data fit

```{r}
# On refait tourner la calibration sans effet juste pour illustrer le fit
detach("package::raster", unload = TRUE)
stock <- "sole7a"
#source("R/case_study/get_SAdata.R")
source(paste0("Data/",stock,"/",stock,".R"))
K <- 2.6*10^7
MSYsearch=FALSE 
Fval <- read.csv2(paste0("Data/",stock,"/","FatA",".csv"), header = T) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% type_convert()
CWatAval <- CWatAval %>% #new problem after R update
  as.data.frame() %>% type_convert()
DYN=TRUE
years <- 1:(maxyear-minyear+1)

source("R/make_data.R")
source("R/Wbar_function.R",local=T)
source("min_K_DYN_function.R") 
K_optim_DYN <- optimize(f=minimize_K_DYN,interval = c(1,10^14),
                        SSB_obs=SSB_SA,Ctot_obs=Ctot_SA,
                        sim_duration=years,age.plus=T)
K_calib_DYN <- K_optim_DYN$minimum

source("R/sim_function_DYN.R")
K <- K_calib_DYN
source("R/make_data.R")
source("R/Wbar_function.R",local=T)
S1 <-  life_cycle_sim_DYN(data=mydata,traj=1,param_R="h",age.plus=T)


years <- c(1970:2021)

plot1<- ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=years, y=SSB_SA, color='Obs'))+
  geom_line(aes(x=years, y=S1$SSB, color="Pred"))+ 
  xlab("Year")+
  ylab("SSB (Kg)")+
  scale_color_manual(name = "SSB", breaks=c("Obs","Pred"),
                     values = c("Obs" = "black", "Pred" = "blue"),
                     guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
                       linetype = c("blank", "solid"),
                       shape = c(16,NA))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=20),axis.text.y = element_text(size=20),text = element_text(size=20))

plot2 <-ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x=years, y=Ctot_SA, color='Obs'))+
  geom_line(aes(x=years, y=S1$C_tot,color="Pred"))+
  xlab("Year")+
  ylab("Catch (Kg)")+
  scale_color_manual(name = "Catch", breaks=c("Obs","Pred"),
                     values = c("Obs" = "black", "Pred" = "blue"),
                     guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
                       linetype = c("blank", "solid"),
                       shape = c(16,NA))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=20),axis.text.y = element_text(size=20),text = element_text(size=20))

plot2
library(ggpubr)
ggplot2 <- ggarrange(plot1,plot2,
                    # labels = c("a)", "b)"),  
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 1, align = "hv",
                    common.legend=F,legend="right")

ggplot2

ggsave(filename = paste0("Figures/Production_curves/", stock,"_fit_obs_pred.tiff"), device="tiff", width = 40, height= 20, units = "cm",dpi=900)
```

### 4.3.b Productions curves & Scenario effect

Results of the sole7a stock with the surface scenario are available in an Excel spreadsheet (SC_Bathy_FINAL).

No quality scenario, combined, global quality and sensitivity analysis of quality assumptions for this case study (at the moment).

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridGraphics)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)

#### Plot répartion juvéniles ####
dens <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 1, ncol=2))
dens[,1] <- c("Sole")
dens[,2] <- c(49.7)
dens$V1 <- fct_relevel(dens$V1, c("Sole"))
colnames(dens) <- c("Espèces", "Pourcentage")

ggplot(dens, aes(x=Espèces, y=Pourcentage, fill=Espèces)) +    
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("deepskyblue4", "bisque3", "chocolate4", "azure4"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=20))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 24),
        legend.text = element_text(size=20))+
  theme(axis.text.x= element_text(colour= "black", size=16))+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())+
  coord_flip()

#### Courbes superposées ####
# http://127.0.0.1:35325/graphics/plot_zoom_png?width=1384&height=764
## Chargement et mise en forme ##
# stock <- "whiting" # espèce a illustrer
sim <- "Bath" # Bath pour scénario de qualité bathymétrique et Global pour la qualité global (deux tableur séparé)

ref <- read.table(paste0("Simulation/MSY_", stock,"ref2",".txt"),header=T) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Zone,F,sim),names_from=type,values_from=c(mean),values_fn = mean)%>%
  filter(Zone=="ALL")
# ref <- ref[-c(102:151),]
ref[,3] <- "Reference"

surf <- read.table(paste0("Simulation/MSY_", stock,"test_ref",".txt"),header=T)%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Zone,F,sim),names_from=type,values_from=c(mean),values_fn = mean)%>%
  filter(Zone=="ALL")
surf[,3] <- "Surface"


da<- bind_rows(ref,surf)
colnames(da) <- c("Zone", "F", "Scenarios", "C", "SSB")
da$Scenarios <- as.factor(da$Scenarios)
da$Scenarios <- fct_relevel(da$Scenarios, c("Reference","Surface"))

## Courbes ##
plot3 <- ggplot(da)+
  geom_line(aes(col=Scenarios, x=F, y=C/1000), size=1.5)+

        legend.text = element_text(size=20))+

ggplot3 <- ggarrange(plot4,plot3,
                    # labels = c("a)", "b)"),  
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 1, align = "hv",
                    common.legend=F,legend="right")

ggplot3

ggsave(filename = paste0("Figures/Production_curves/", stock,"_fit_ssb.tiff"), device="tiff", width = 40, height= 20, units = "cm",dpi=900)

#### Chargement et mise en forme du tableur excel ####

Article_sc_bathy <- bind_rows(MSY,MSY_ref)
write.csv(Article_sc_bathy, "~/Scenarios/Article_sc_bathy.csv", row.names=FALSE)

df <- read.csv2("Scenarios/Article_sc_bathy.csv") %>% 
    dplyr::rename(Zone = Zone,F = F,Parametre = sim,Catch = C, SSB = SSB) %>% 
    mutate(Parametre = recode_factor(Parametre, "sole7abath_surf"="surface", "sole7atest_rmd2"="reference")) %>% 
    mutate(SSB = as.numeric(SSB)) %>% 
    mutate(Catch = as.numeric(Catch)) %>% 
    mutate(SSB_surf=(max(SSB)*100)/min(SSB)-100) %>% 
    mutate(Catch_surf=(max(Catch)*100)/min(Catch)-100) %>% 
    mutate(Species=stock) %>% 
    dplyr::select(c(Species,F,SSB_surf,Catch_surf)) %>% 
    mutate(Value= c(SSB_surf[1],Catch_surf[1]),
           Categorie=c("SSB_surf","Catch_surf")) %>% 
    dplyr::select(c(Species,F,Value,Categorie))
                                     
#### Graph barplot augmentation de SSB et captures au MSY ####

ggplot(df, aes(fill=Categorie, y=Value, x=Categorie)) + 
  geom_bar(position="dodge", stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("tomato3","deepskyblue4"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
        text = element_text(size=14))+
  ylab("Increase at MSY (in %)")+
  xlab("Scenarios")+
  theme(axis.text.x= element_text(colour= "black", size=16))+
  theme(axis.text.y= element_text(colour= "black", size=16))+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=20))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 24),
        legend.text = element_text(size=20))+ 
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text= element_blank()
  )+
        scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0,5,10,15,20), limits = c(0,10))
```
